# Rubiks Trainer

> > Comprehensive speedcubing platform offering CFOP method training, algorithm libraries (PLL, OLL, F2L, COLL), practice timers, and tutorials for solving the Rubik's Cube faster.

Rubiks Trainer is a dedicated speedcubing resource that helps beginners and intermediate solvers master the CFOP (Cross, F2L, OLL, PLL) method through interactive algorithm practice, recognition training, and timed solving sessions. The platform provides detailed notation guides, step-by-step tutorials, and comprehensive algorithm references for all stages of the solve.

## Key Topics

- CFOP Method
- PLL (Permutation of Last Layer)
- OLL (Orientation of Last Layer)
- F2L (First 2 Layers)
- COLL
- Speedcubing
- Algorithm Recognition
- Cross and X-Cross
- Cube Notation
- AUF (Adjust U Face)
- Layer-by-Layer Method
- Practice Timer
- Algorithm Training
- Rubik's Cube Solving

## Getting Started

- [Rubiks Trainer Homepage](https://www.rubikstrainer.com/): Main hub for speedcubing algorithms, practice timer, and training tools
- [How to Solve the Rubik's Cube](https://www.rubikstrainer.com/howto): Beginner-friendly guide to solving the Rubik's Cube using CFOP method with detailed notation explanations

## Algorithm Reference

- [PLL Ub Permutation](https://www.rubikstrainer.com/PLL/103): PLL algorithm reference for Ub permutation case with practice exercises
